tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Current Fleek prices for digital subscriptions, read live from Fleek's public catalogue. With a brand, returns each of its plans on sale with Fleek's price, list price (MRP), saving, duration, delivery (code or activation) and a link to the brand page. Without a brand, returns up to 8 brands (optionally in one category) with each brand's biggest saving. Brands and prices are those of the given country's store, in its currency.

category.description: streaming, music, news, antivirus, productivity, AI tools, gaming, entertainment, fitness, learning, lifestyle or gift cards (or the catalogue's own names such as OTT).

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: All plans on sale on Fleek for one brand, side by side and shortest first: Fleek's price, list price (MRP), saving, duration, the price per month for month and year plans, delivery (code or activation), and the brand page link. Brands and prices are those of the given country's store, in its currency.

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.

tools.name: how_fleek_works
tools.description: Facts about the Fleek app and website, each with the platform it applies to and a reference page: the subscription manager (tracking renewals, reminders, finding forgotten subscriptions, splitting plans), buying subscriptions, FleekCoin rewards and cancelling. Also returns the app store and web links. topic narrows the answer to subscription_manager, buying, rewards or cancelling.

topic.description: subscription_manager, buying, rewards or cancelling. Omit for all four.

tools.name: get_fleek_app
tools.description: Download and web links for Fleek: Google Play for Android, the App Store for iPhone (in the countries where it's listed), and web.getfleek.app. With a country, the result says which of these are listed there.

platform.description: android, ios or web. Omit for all three.

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.
